_provenance: Captured by a pass-through proxy from the real pay CLI (v0.28.0) during the mainnet attempt on 2026-09-19. This transaction was signed by the throwaway payer and offered to the server, but NEVER submitted: sendTransaction preflight rejected it (Blockhash not found) so it never reached the network. Its blockhash is long expired, so these bytes are unexecutable.
_note: The credential as a whole is NOT reusable end-to-end: its challenge expired (TTL 300s). Only payload.transaction is reused, against a freshly minted challenge.
_signatureNote: The transaction signature, decoded independently with @solana/kit (not with mpp/signature.js). A real RPC returns exactly this from sendTransaction, so the test stub must too.
